description: Strings that stage 6 renders on every card page, the same for all 78 cards of a language. Card JSON files must not repeat them. Placeholders: {Card} = name_forms.name, {card} = name_forms.in_sentence, {card_de} = name_forms.de (es), {Other} = the paired card's name, {numeral}, {suit}, {rank}, {label}, {label_reversed} (yes-no-rules.json labels), {reason} (meanings.<lang>.json yes_no_why), {pages} (formatted page list), {editor_name}, {reviewed_at} (formatted date). waite.harsh_context: This is how cards were read in 1911; we don't read the card this way today.
waite.boundary: Everything below is the modern reading used on Arcana Diary. Where a line comes from Waite, we name him and give the page.

work_money.money_line: This is what the card means for money, not a forecast or financial advice.

yes_no.rule: On Arcana Diary an upright card gives its base answer, and every reversed card moves it to "Not clear yet". That is not a bad sign: the answer is still forming.

in_a_reading.note: The card describes a role, not a real person. What it says about feelings is the card's traditional meaning, not a statement about someone in your life.

combinations.intro: These pairs are modern readings, built on Arcana Diary's meanings for each card.

about.deck_note: These are the meanings of the 1909 Rider–Waite–Smith deck, drawn by Pamela Colman Smith; the Marseille tradition reads the cards differently.

waite.cite: A. E. Waite, The Pictorial Key to the Tarot (1911), {pages}
waite.harsh_context: Así se leían las cartas en 1911; hoy no la leemos así.
waite.boundary: Todo lo que sigue es la lectura moderna que usamos en Arcana Diary. Cuando algo viene de Waite, lo decimos y damos la página.

work_money.money_line: Esto es lo que la carta significa para el dinero, no un pronóstico ni un consejo financiero.

yes_no.rule: En Arcana Diary, una carta al derecho da su respuesta base, y toda carta al revés la cambia a «Todavía no está claro». No es mala señal: la respuesta todavía se está formando.

in_a_reading.note: La carta describe un papel, no a una persona real. Lo que dice sobre los sentimientos es su significado tradicional, no una afirmación sobre alguien de tu vida.

combinations.intro: Estas parejas son lecturas modernas, basadas en los significados de cada carta en Arcana Diary.
